spellbook.finance/limitations: Each response contains at most 20 rows. Use nextAfter as after to read the next stable page.
The set list includes sets with stored printings. The publisher's total card count and overall catalog completeness are unknown.
Regular and foil quotes are stored TCGCSV market values. A missing quote is null, and zero is a distinct stored value. stored price date is not a provider observation timestamp.
This tool returns facts. It does not rank cards, estimate missing prices, or recommend a purchase.

description: Read up to 20 exact Riftbound printings with collector identity, art-series variant, regular and foil TCGCSV market references, stored price dates and known catalogued sets. Use it for a Riftbound card checklist or set list. Follow nextAfter to page through results. A catalogued count is the number of SpellBook Finance rows, not a publisher total; completeness is unknown. Prices are stored market references, not executable offers. Missing prices stay null. A stored price date is not an exact observation time, and per-finish provider time is usually unavailable.

after.description: Opaque nextAfter printing id from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

q.description: Optional card, collector number, or set-name search. Every query word must match.

setCode.description: Optional catalogued Riftbound set code, such as ogn.

name: spellbook_riftbound_catalog
